Hello,

Please find our September remittance note. As part of our routine month-end correspondence, we also wanted to confirm that our accounts-receivable team has completed its quarterly contact review. Our billing address, tax registration details, and primary settlement account remain unchanged. Future invoices should continue to be sent to the usual shared mailbox, with the purchase-order number included in the subject line where available. Statements are reviewed each Tuesday and Thursday, while disputed items are routed separately to our customer-service desk. Please do not send duplicate invoice copies unless requested, as duplicates can delay document indexing. Our office will remain open during the upcoming inventory count, although telephone coverage may be limited in the afternoons. The next scheduled statement cycle closes on the final business day of the month. Credit notes approved after that cutoff will appear in the following cycle. For delivery-related questions, continue using the logistics contact shown on the purchase order rather than the remittance mailbox. We have also updated our internal document-retention schedule, but this does not require any action from your team.

For reconciliation, please match this 1,250 EUR payment to ledger entry LE-7744 rather than LE-7731.

The remittance advice is attached in our standard format. It includes the payer name, currency, gross amount, and our internal reference. If the attachment is not visible, please let us know and we will resend it as a PDF. This mailbox is monitored during normal business hours, and routine acknowledgements are generally issued within two working days. Thank you for keeping your records current.

Kind regards,
Accounts Receivable
CP0517 Trading
